faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear, honest answers about our methodology, scope, and guarantees.

q1.question: Does Skill Setu guarantee a job, placement, or interview?
q1.answer: No. Skill Setu is an educational benchmarking and skill gap diagnostics tool, not a recruitment agency, staffing firm, or placement bootcamp. We help you systematically uncover where your technical skills fall short of industry role benchmarks and connect you with free curricula to bridge those gaps. Hiring decisions depend on employers, market dynamics, and your independent project portfolio.

q2.question: How are diagnostic questions scored and evaluated?
q2.answer: Every diagnostic assessment calculates a score using clear competency frameworks on a 1.0 to 5.0 scale. Option orders are shuffled on every attempt to eliminate positional bias, and questions feature explanations for both correct choices and common misconceptions.

q3.question: Are the recommended learning paths genuinely free?
q3.answer: Yes. Our catalog indexes over 60 free courses from open educational providers including Microsoft Learn, Google Cloud Skills Boost, freeCodeCamp, CS50, and NPTEL. You will never encounter a paywall inside our recommended course pathways.

q4.question: Can I change my target career role after signing up?
q4.answer: Yes. You can change or compare target roles at any time in your profile dashboard. Switching roles automatically re-computes your readiness score and reprioritizes your course suggestions.
